name: Moonkissed
text:
**Moonkissed**: Some Spiresworn, especially those born within the Spire itself, are mystically warded from birth against dangers both mental and physical. Elves with this alternate racial trait gain a +1 racial bonus on saving throws.

This replaces elven immunities and keen senses.
